attribution: All application credit remains with the original Dispatcharr authors and contributors. See ../../ATTRIBUTION.md.
scope: No-job ServerGroup and M3UFilter management CRUD against the original Django API; partial M6 slice, not full backend or native ingestion acceptance.
source_quirks_verified: M3UFilter ModelSerializer/create/update does not call model.clean/full_clean: malformed regex is accepted by the API, while normal string/length/choice/bool/integer validators still run.
PUT requires regex_pattern but preserves omitted optional fields; nested account/id fields and unknown payload keys cannot move or reidentify a filter.
JSON write responses retain original request number types; subsequent GET observes PostgreSQL JSONB canonical values.
ServerGroup names use source100-character limit, trimming/coercion, uniqueness and required create/PUT semantics.
ServerGroup deletion performs collector SET_NULL without account.save, timestamp changes or account/profile refresh signals.
normalization: Only generated IDs for independently created ServerGroup/filter lifecycle rows. Readonly identity preservation is checked before normalization.
No field-value, JSON-number-type, regex, validation-error or timestamp normalization. Response bodies/credentials are never recorded.
fixture_policy: Only disposable loopback Compose fixtures; exact owned rust-probe names/IDs are cleaned.
Restricted source metadata_fixture helper links only the owned inactive provider to the exact owned ServerGroup using QuerySet.update, without save/job signals.
No external provider URL or import/refresh job is exercised.
scope_exclusions: Image8 may contain intermediate Timeshift idle/reopen bytes and unverified native compression/prepared work; these oracles make no acceptance claim for those components.
Account/profile/EPG-source mutations, native jobs/cache/notifications and uncommon FK/database-race/HTML parser errors remain pending.
